files.name: Lease agreement - 14 Riverside Lane.pdf
files.text:
Residential lease agreement
This lease is made on 1 September 2025 between Riverside Homes Ltd (the landlord) and Alex
Example (the tenant) for Apartment 2, 14 Riverside Lane.
1. Term
The lease runs for twelve months, from 1 September 2025 to 31 August 2026, and may be
renewed by written agreement.
2. Rent
Monthly rent is 1,150 USD, payable on the first day of each month. A security deposit of one
month's rent is held for the length of the lease.
3. Pets
One cat or one small dog is permitted with the landlord's written consent. The tenant is
responsible for any damage caused by pets.
4. Repairs and inspection
The landlord will repair the heating, plumbing and windows within a reasonable time. The
landlord may inspect the apartment with 48 hours' notice.
5. Ending the lease
Either party may end the lease after the term with two months' written notice.
Signed by both parties on 1 September 2025.

files.text:
# Lisbon packing list

- Passport and the printed hotel booking
- Comfortable walking shoes for the hills
- Light jacket for the evenings by the river
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Travel adapter (type F)
- Camera, spare battery and the external drive
- Tram 28 day ticket, bought at the station

files.name: Margherita pizza recipe.txt
files.text:
Margherita pizza (makes two)

Dough: 500 g flour, 325 ml warm water, 7 g dried yeast, 10 g salt, a splash of olive oil.
Mix, knead for ten minutes and leave to rise for two hours.

Sauce: one tin of crushed tomatoes, a pinch of salt, a little garlic. Do not cook it.

Topping: fresh mozzarella, torn, and a handful of fresh basil after baking.

Bake on the hottest setting, on a preheated tray, for 8 to 10 minutes.
Pizza night is Friday. Buy two bottles of sparkling water.

files.name: Safari notes.txt
files.text:
Safari, day 3

Left camp at six. A whole herd of elephants crossed the track right in front of us,
maybe twenty of them, with two calves at the back. The guide switched the engine off
and we waited for almost ten minutes.

Later: two zebras grazing near the river, one young. Lunch under an acacia tree.
Tomorrow we drive north to the lake.
